entries.10b9da2b18b26181: Develops, sells, leases and brokers real estate, and plans and sells wooden detached houses. These activities are carried out by Takamatsu House, Takamatsu Estate and others, and the company also conducts real estate investment in the United States. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥84,100 million, an increase of 2.3% from the previous year.

entries.5bb2bba6fc58760d: Undertakes civil engineering work. Aoki Asunaro Construction and Mirai Construction Industry engage in both building and civil engineering, Aoki Marine handles marine civil engineering, Toko Geotech handles slope protection and ground improvement, and Shimada-gumi conducts archaeological excavation surveys. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥100,736 million, a decrease of 0.7% from the previous year.
entries.8124933afa419088: Undertakes building construction work for apartment buildings and similar projects. The work is carried out by Takamatsu Construction, Aoki Asunaro Construction, and others, as well as Kongo Gumi, which handles shrine and temple construction, and Takamatsu Techno Service, which handles renovation. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥172,838 million, an increase of 6.0% from the previous year.
entries.96cb97ad70745c57: A holding company of a construction group engaged in building and civil engineering construction and in real estate development and sales.
